patterns.comment: The body holds tiddler lines. Wikitext reads inside a value, never at line level, so an unmatched line cannot open a run that swallows the lines after it. A file whose header names no `type` reads every line's text as wikitext, the way TiddlyWiki reads a tiddler with no type.

3.name: meta.tiddle.field.text.tiddlywiki5.multids-file text.html.tiddlywiki5
3.comment: A tiddler text field, one line of it. A pragma anchors on ^ and this capture opens mid-line, so no definition stands here and no definition body follows.

titleline.comment: boot.js takes the first colon on the line: the title runs up to it and the text follows. A line with no value defines a tiddler with empty text.

typed-body.comment: The header's own `type` field governs every tiddler in the file — boot.js#application/x-tiddlers parses the header once and extends the same fields, `type` included, onto every `title: text` line that follows the blank line (boot.js ~1706-1728). Mirrors tw5-tid-file.json#typed-body: the type line opens a region that never closes, the remaining header fields read inside it, and every line of the body after the blank line reads its text as the guest language. A type nothing here names leaves every line reading as wikitext, the way TiddlyWiki reads a tiddler with no type.

titleline-json.comment: boot.js hands every tiddler in this file the header's own `type` field — one `type:` governs all of it, so a `json` header routes every `title: text` line's text through source.json, the same guest tiddlywiki5.tid-file routes a `.tid` body through for this type. A begin/end block carries the embed rather than a captured `match`, because vscode-textmate resolves a cross-grammar `include` reliably only there — measured against tw5-tid-file.json's own working embed and against a `match` capture's `patterns`, which never brought a foreign grammar's tokens in on this tree.
